title: Declare SCP Core Constraints as Non-Bypassable Boundaries
decision: Define SCP core constraints to establish absolute boundaries protecting human self-creation.
context: As systems gain memory and optimization power, explicit limits are required to prevent silent erosion of agency and identity.
rationale: Without declared stopping points, optimization inevitably consumes self-creation.
consequences: Future systems must treat these boundaries as inviolable, regardless of efficiency gains.
scp_risk_notes: Core constraints define absolute stopping points for system behavior.
